description:
This role is for one of our clients 
 Compensation: $70 - $90 per hour 
 
 Employment Type: Independent Contractor
 Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
 Working Schedule: Flexible – Work on your own schedule
 Payment Frequency: Weekly via Stripe or Wise
 About the Role
 We are seeking experienced Cloud Engineers with strong expertise in AWS serverless architecture and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) to contribute to an AI research initiative focused on improving the capabilities of advanced AI models.
 In this role, you will evaluate the quality, correctness, and architectural soundness of AWS serverless applications and infrastructure tasks used to train and assess frontier AI systems. You will review multi-service serverless designs, infrastructure configurations, event-driven workflows, and cross-service integrations to ensure they are technically accurate, secure, scalable, and aligned with real-world cloud engineering practices.
 Your hands-on AWS experience will be essential in identifying architectural flaws, incorrect service integrations, security and permission issues, unreliable event processing, and gaps between local testing environments and actual AWS behaviour.
 You will provide structured, rubric-based feedback to help establish reliable evaluation standards and improve AI model performance on complex cloud engineering tasks.
 Requirements 
 Key Responsibilities
 1. AWS Serverless Architecture Evaluation 
 Evaluate multi-service AWS serverless applications and architecture designs.
 Review implementations involving AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, DynamoDB Streams, S3, EventBridge, SNS, SQS, and Step Functions.
 Assess the correctness of event-driven architectures, service integrations, and asynchronous processing workflows.
 Identify architectural weaknesses, integration failures, and implementation gaps.
 Evaluate whether proposed solutions meet real-world requirements for scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
 2. Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) Review 
 Review infrastructure-as-code implementations developed using AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or AWS SAM.
 Assess whether infrastructure definitions accurately represent the intended cloud architecture.
 Identify configuration errors, deployment issues, missing dependencies, and inconsistencies between infrastructure definitions and application behaviour.
 Evaluate the correctness, maintainability, and reproducibility of infrastructure deployments.
 Verify that IaC implementations follow AWS best practices.
 3. Security, Reliability & Event Processing 
 Assess IAM policies, role configurations, access controls, and permission boundaries.
 Identify excessive permissions, security gaps, and incorrectly configured service access.
 Evaluate event-driven processing logic, including retry mechanisms, failure handling, dead-letter queues, and message delivery semantics.
 Review fault tolerance, error recovery, and cross-service communication patterns.
 Identify potential issues affecting application reliability, data integrity, and operational stability.
 4. Testing, Emulation & Validation 
 Evaluate the quality and reliability of local testing and cloud emulation environments.
 Assess the fidelity of tools such as LocalStack compared with actual AWS service behaviour.
 Identify differences between local emulation results and real AWS execution.
 Review integration tests and deployment validation workflows to ensure they accurately reflect production environments.
 Assess whether cloud solutions are reproducible and function correctly under realistic deployment conditions.
 5. Research Collaboration & Technical Feedback 
 Collaborate with AI researchers, engineers, and cloud infrastructure specialists to improve evaluation tasks.
 Provide clear, structured, and actionable written feedback based on predefined evaluation rubrics.
 Translate practical AWS architecture expertise into measurable standards for assessing AI-generated cloud solutions.
 Help refine benchmark tasks and evaluation methodologies to improve technical accuracy and consistency.
 Required Qualifications & Skills
 Professional Experience 
 Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience building and maintaining multi-service AWS serverless applications.
 Practical experience designing, developing, and integrating serverless solutions in AWS environments.
 Strong understanding of distributed and event-driven application architectures.
 Experience evaluating cloud infrastructure implementations and identifying architectural issues.
 AWS & Serverless Architecture Expertise 
 Strong hands-on experience with AWS services, including:
 AWS Lambda
 Amazon API Gateway
 Amazon DynamoDB and DynamoDB Streams
 Amazon S3
 Amazon EventBridge
 Amazon SNS and SQS
 AWS Step Functions
 Ability to assess multi-service integrations and event-driven processing workflows.
 Strong understanding of serverless application design, scalability, reliability, and fault tolerance.
 Infrastructure-as-Code Expertise 
 Hands-on experience with at least one of the following:
 AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK)
 AWS CloudFormation
 AWS Serverless Application Model (SAM)
 Ability to review, validate, and troubleshoot infrastructure definitions.
 Understanding of deployment workflows, resource dependencies, configuration management, and infrastructure reproducibility.
 Security & Reliability 
 Strong understanding of AWS IAM, access policies, permission boundaries, and least-privilege principles.
 Experience evaluating event-processing correctness, retry behaviour, failure handling, and message delivery semantics.
 Ability to identify security vulnerabilities and architectural reliability issues.
 Testing & Validation 
 Familiarity with local AWS emulation and testing tools such as LocalStack.
 Ability to assess differences between local emulation and real AWS service behaviour.
 Experience with integration testing, cloud deployment validation, and debugging distributed applications.
 Analytical & Communication Skills 
 Strong technical problem-solving and architectural evaluation capabilities.
 Excellent attention to detail and ability to identify subtle implementation errors.
 Strong written communication skills, with the ability to provide precise, structured, and actionable feedback.
 Preferred Qualifications
 AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect or AWS Certified Developer.
 Experience with observability, monitoring, logging, and tracing for serverless workloads.
 Knowledge of serverless cost optimisation and performance tuning.
 Previous experience in code reviews, technical assessments, or task grading.
 Experience evaluating cloud architecture designs against production-level engineering standards.
 Contract & Payment Terms
 Engagement will be on an independent contractor basis.
 The role is fully remote and offers flexible working hours, allowing you to complete assignments on your own schedule.
 Project duration may be extended, shortened, or concluded early depending on business requirements and individual performance.
 Payments will be processed weekly through Stripe or Wise, based on services rendered.
 The role will not require access to confidential or proprietary information belonging to any current or former employer, client, or institution.
 Candidates requiring H-1B or STEM OPT sponsorship are not eligible for this opportunity at present.
